paper.title_en: Conformal geodesics and the hyperboloid at timelike infinity
paper.abstract_en: A description of scattering in asymptotically flat spacetimes that includes both radiation and massive asymptotic states requires control of the relation between null and timelike infinity. Motivated by this problem, we use the properties of conformal geodesics to construct an extended representation of timelike infinity in Minkowski spacetime. The construction exploits the fact that every non-null metric geodesic in an Einstein spacetime is, up to an explicit local reparametrisation, a conformal geodesic. It replaces the point $i^+$ by a hyperboloidal boundary $\mathcal{H}^+$ meeting future null infinity $\mathscr{I}^+$ at a corner $\mathcal{C}^{+}$, while fixing the location of $\mathscr{I}^+$ in the associated conformal Gaussian gauge. In this gauge, we derive the equations governing massless scalar and spin-$2$ fields. In particular, we obtain a transport equation for the scalar field along future null infinity and analyse the asymptotic behaviour of its spherical-harmonic modes near timelike infinity. We also derive the explicit massless spin-$2$ equations in this gauge. Finally, we examine the relation to projective extensions and to the hyperbolic base of the extended Carrollian space $\mathrm{Ti}$. Our results provide a geometric framework for studying the connection between late-time and null asymptotics which is a prerequisite for scattering constructions relevant to flat space holography.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文利用共形测地线在闵可夫斯基时空中构造类时无穷的扩展双曲面表示，并推导质量为零的标量与自旋-2场在共形高斯规范下的方程，涉及渐近平坦时空、零无穷与类时无穷的衔接，属于广义相对论基础中关于时空渐近结构与散射几何框架的理论工作，理论深度较高，适合点击进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 共形测地线与类时无穷处的双曲面
decision.abstract_zh: 一种同时包含辐射与有质量渐近态的渐近平坦时空散射描述，需要控制零无穷与类时无穷之间的关系。受此问题启发，我们利用共形测地线的性质，在闵可夫斯基时空中构造类时无穷的扩展表示。该构造利用了如下事实：爱因斯坦时空中的每一条非零度规测地线，在相差一个显式的局部重参数化意义下，都是一条共形测地线。它将点 $i^+$ 替换为一个双曲面型边界 $\mathcal{H}^+$，该边界与未来零无穷 $\mathscr{I}^+$ 相交于一个角 $\mathcal{C}^{+}$，同时在与该构造相关联的共形高斯规范中固定 $\mathscr{I}^+$ 的位置。在此规范下，我们推导了支配无质量标量场与自旋-$2$ 场的方程。特别地，我们得到了标量场沿未来零无穷的输运方程，并分析了其球谐模式在类时无穷附近的渐近行为。我们还推导了该规范下显式的无质量自旋-$2$ 方程。最后，我们考察了其与射影扩展以及扩展的卡罗尔空间 $\mathrm{Ti}$ 的双曲底空间之间的关系。我们的结果为研究晚期渐近与零渐近之间的联系提供了一个几何框架，而这一联系是与平坦空间全息相关的散射构造的前提条件。
